findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_quote_forms · Private data: get_life_quotes · Public sink: submit_quote_request, start_life_application.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_quote_forms · Private data: get_life_quotes · Public sink: submit_quote_request, start_life_application

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_quote_forms" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the insurance quote request forms Susman Insurance Agency offers (auto, home, condo, renters, landlord, earthquake, flood, life and more), with a short description, question count and the human web page for each." → after: "List the insurance quote request forms Susman Insurance Agency offers (auto, home, condo, renters, landlord, earthquake, flood, life and more), with a short description, question count and the human web page for each, and whether an instant online quote, or a real-time price quote in chat, also exis"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
